adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is derived with case-sensitive exact matches: it filters out existing attendees via `guest === attendee.email` and filters blacklist via `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` where `blacklistedGuestEmails` are lowercased but `guest` is not (lines shown around the `uniqueGuests` filter). This allows adding `User@X.com` when `user@x.com` already exists, creating duplicate attendee rows (via `createMany`) and bypassing the blacklist by casing. The later email logic `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` also uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` case-sensitively, compounding incorrect behavior.
